files.purpose: AppModel.swift defines the @MainActor @Observable AppModel class that owns the whole library (the projects and threads arrays), the long-lived stores built at launch (AppSettings, ProviderRegistry, MCPStore, TerminalStore, SidebarLayout, AutoContinue) and every operation that spans more than one thread: project add/remove, thread create/forward/move/rename/archive/settle/reopen/delete, sidebar ordering and drag reorder, helper (subagent) spawning and closing, idle runtime release, git worktree creation, attention (notifications, dock bounce, dock badge), text-generation engine choice and library persistence (400 ms debounce plus a synchronous save at quit). To keep SwiftUI re-renders local it mirrors the arrays into per-item ObservedValue cells (project, thread, child-id and selection cells) plus a ThreadIndex of positions, so single lookups (`thread(_:)`, `project(_:)`, `isSelected(_:)`, `children(of:)`) depend only on the item read. The file also declares the AppAlert value type and the ProjectFile enum that reads project scripts from `droppy-code.json` and maps its icon names to SF Symbol names.

side_effects: init: Storage.loadLibrary(); every thread with lastStatus == .running becomes .interrupted; every hydra status .running becomes .stopped with finishedAt = .now; clears settings.lastProjectID when that project no longer exists. These rewrites are in memory only: init (120-146) calls neither scheduleSave nor saveLibrary (and property observers do not fire in an initializer), so they reach disk with the next save.

bootstrap: warms the 12 most recently updated non-archived, non-panel threads; loads keychain; LoginEnvironment.load(); sweepHydraCopies(); await resumeHydraMerges(); starts a repeating task that sleeps 300 s then calls resumeHydraMerges() until cancelled; providers.refreshAll(); loads catalogs for [.claude, .codex, .deepseek, .meta] concurrently (installed only), then .zai if installed; unless WebsiteCaptures.isEnabled, Storage.sweepOrphanedAttachments()

Idle stop: only for a runtime that exists when the thread is left; after 600 s unselected and not running, runtime.stopSession(), idle timer cleared, then releaseIdleRuntime (which may refuse, leaving the runtime with its session stopped); loops again every 600 s while a turn runs

feature_notes: Cell sync: `sync` writes only cells whose value changed, creates cells for new items, and empties (writes nil) and removes cells of items that are gone; writes are returned and applied afterward by `write` because a write inside withAnimation makes SwiftUI rebuild menu-bar commands that read `thread(_:)` and would trap on exclusivity if the dictionary were still borrowed.
threads didSet rebuilds ThreadIndex only when the count differs from positions.count, or any thread's index or projectID differs from what the index/cell held; metadata-only changes do not rebuild.

syncChildCells keeps a cell for a parent that still exists even with zero children (a chat waiting for its first head watches it); a parent cell is removed only when the parent thread is gone and has no children. childIDs(of:) lazily creates an empty cell on first read.

selectedThreadID didSet order: (1) if changed, old selection cell false, new selection cell true, SwitchLatency.noteSwitch(to: title ?? "none"); (2) if non-nil, a Task marks the thread and its children read (deferred so the click never rewrites the library); (3) if changed, scheduleIdleSessionStop(leaving: old) and a Task warmNeighbors(of: new); (4) rememberLastProject for the selected thread's project.
currentProject fallback order: selected thread's project, settings.lastProjectID's project, project of the most recently updated non-archived non-panel thread, projects.first.

threads(in:) excludes archived and in-panel threads, and excludes helpers whose parent is among the shown threads. Sort: unsettled before settled; settled by settledFirst ((settledAt ?? updatedAt) descending); then pinned first; then sortOrder ascending where both set and different; a thread with nil sortOrder goes above one with a value; otherwise createdAt descending.

moveThread(_:to:placeAfter:) only within one project and only among unsettled threads; the moved thread takes the target's isPinned; every unsettled thread gets sortOrder = Double(position). Returns false when the order is unchanged.
moveInActivity sets activityOrder = Double(position) and activityOrderDay = Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: thread.updatedAt) on every peer.
sidebarThreads: expanded projects only; each thread followed by helpers(of:) unless foldsHelpers or isSettled.

helpers(of:): children not archived and (not in panel or is a Hydra head), createdAt descending. panelHeads(of:): in panel, not archived, Hydra heads, sorted by hydra.index (nil as Int.max) then createdAt ascending. panelSubagent(of:) and subagent(of:): first child in panel, not archived, not a Hydra head.
bootstrap timings: merge sweep every 300 seconds ("every five minutes"); first-document warm set is prefix(12) of non-archived, non-panel threads by updatedAt descending.

Idle session stop: 600 seconds ("ten minutes"); cancelled for the newly selected thread; a running turn re-waits another 600 s. releaseIdleRuntime refuses when the thread is selected, when its parent is the selected thread (panel on screen), when runtime.holdsOnlyPersistedState is false, when it is in sessionsToRelease, when autoContinue.resumesAt has an entry, when terminals.sessions(for:) is non-empty, or when runningDroppyHeads(of:) != 0. scheduleIdleSessionStop (470-488) first cancels any stop for the newly selected thread, then `guard let id, runtimes[id] != nil else { return }` (474): no timer when the left thread has no runtime. The task returns without action if cancelled, the thread was selected again or the runtime was dropped (479). Otherwise it calls `runtime.stopSession()` and `self.idleSessionStops[id] = nil` (482-483) before `self.releaseIdleRuntime(id)` (484), whether or not the release then refuses: a refused runtime stays with its session stopped and no further idle timer until the thread is selected and left again.
workingDirectory = selected thread's worktreePath ?? project.path.

addProject (516-524): `let path = url.standardizedFileURL.path`; `if let existing = projects.first(where: { $0.path == path }) { return existing }` (exact string compare; re-adding a known path returns the stored project and does NOT re-read droppy-code.json). A new project is `Project(name: url.lastPathComponent, path: path)` with `project.scripts = ProjectFile.scripts(at: url)`; that line 520 is the only caller of ProjectFile.scripts in the whole B2 tree (grep), so droppy-code.json is read once, when the project is first added, and the result persists as `project.scripts`. Windows port note: paths are case-insensitive and accept either slash, so an exact string compare would create duplicate projects. chooseProjectFolder opens the panel then newThread(in: last added). addProjectsFromPanel returns the last URL's project or nil on cancel.
removeProject discards state for every thread in the project, removes them and the project, clears lastProjectID if it pointed there, clears selection if the selected thread is gone.

openThreadOnLaunch (574-602) starts with `guard let project = currentProject else { return }`: with no project it does nothing (no folder panel, no thread), unlike newThread which calls chooseProjectFolder() (606-608). It reuses the thread picked by `.filter { $0.projectID == project.id && !$0.isArchived && !$0.isSettled && !$0.isHelper && $0.lastStatus == nil && !$0.hasCustomTitle && $0.title == ChatThread.untitled }.max { $0.createdAt < $1.createdAt }` (newest by createdAt, not updatedAt); it is refreshed to what makeThread(in: project, carrying: nil) would give (provider, model, effort, fastMode, hydraPairID, hydraEnabled; providerSessionID and providerResumeAt cleared if the provider changed) and selected. Otherwise newThread(in: project).

newThread: with no project available, opens chooseProjectFolder() and returns nil. Carries the selected thread; expands the project; selects the new thread; if (workspace ?? settings.defaultWorkspaceMode) == .worktree, creates a worktree in a Task.

forwardThread (624-646): `let sourceRuntime = runtime(for: sourceID)` then `await sourceRuntime.ensureLoaded()` creates (runtime(for:) 425-429 stores it in `runtimes`) and keeps a runtime for the SOURCE thread holding its history in memory; nothing here releases it (only the idle-stop path or a delete does). After re-resolving source and project, it captures ThreadContinuation.capture(sourceID:title:document: sourceRuntime.snapshotForPersistence()), makes the thread with makeThread(in: project, carrying: resolved), sets title "Continued: " + resolved.title and hasCustomTitle = true, then `threads.append(thread)` (638), `updateProject(project.id) { $0.isExpanded = true }` (639) and `rememberLastProject(project.id)` (640) all run BEFORE `guard await newRuntime.installContinuation(continuation), self.thread(thread.id) != nil else { return nil }` (642). On failure the "Continued: ..." thread stays in the list, unselected, with its runtime in `runtimes`, and the scheduleSave() at 644 is skipped (the thread reaches disk only through some other save, e.g. the scheduleSave inside updateProject when isExpanded actually changed, 553-555). On success: selectedThreadID = thread.id, scheduleSave(), returns the thread.

makeThread provider precedence: project's Hydra pair provider, current thread's provider, last pair's provider (only when current == nil and settings.hydraEnabled; lastPairID = settings.lastHydraPairID ?? most recently updated non-helper thread's hydraPairID), settings.defaultProvider; if installed-and-enabled providers exist and the choice is not among them, installed[0] (ProviderKind.allCases order). carriesModel = projectPair?.orchestratorModel == nil && current?.provider == provider; `let model = carriesModel ? current?.model : providers.defaultModel(for: provider)?.id`; `let preference = settings.preference(for: provider, model: model)` (keyed by provider AND the carried-or-default model id); `effort = carriesModel ? current?.effort : (preference.effort ?? settings.lastEffort(for: provider))`; `fastMode = carriesModel ? (current?.fastMode ?? false) : preference.fastMode`. runtimeMode = settings.defaultRuntimeMode. Project pair then overrides with hydraLead model/effort/fastMode, hydraPairID and hydraEnabled = true; else carriesModel copies current.hydraPairID; else last pair (same provider) applies its lead.
updateThread/updateProject write only when the value changed, then scheduleSave(). updateThreads applies to the whole array once.

moveThread(_:toProject:) (720-732) calls `existingRuntime(for: id)?.stopSession()` (the runtime itself is kept), sets projectID, clears worktreePath, branch, providerSessionID, providerResumeAt, expands the destination, remembers it and sets sidebarRevealThreadID = id. It does NOT remove the old worktree from disk nor delete checkpoints, so the worktree folder and its `droppy-code/<suffix>` branch are left behind. The doc comment says "Wrap the call in `withAnimation` to make the move glide in the sidebar; the model itself never animates": the caller animates.
rename trims whitespace and newlines (via String.trimmed), ignores an empty result, sets title and hasCustomTitle = true.

archive (757-772) recurses through `for helper in helpers(of: id) { archive(helper.id) }` (759), so only helpers matching `!$0.isArchived && (!$0.isInPanel || $0.isHydraHead)` (398) go with it: a non-Hydra helper still in its floating panel (isInPanel && !isHydraHead) is NOT archived with its parent. Then selects a neighbour if the thread was selected, stops the session, releaseHydraCopy(of:), sets isArchived = true, isPinned = false, isSettled = false, settledAt = nil, updates the dock badge. unarchive (774-781) restores the thread and every direct child with `helper.parentThreadID == id && helper.isArchived` (776), including helpers the user had archived separately before, then updates the dock badge.

settle (787-807) ignores settled or helper threads; sets isSettled, settledAt = now, isPinned = false, hasUnread = false on the thread; then `for helper in helpers(of: id)` (797) sets only `isSettled = true` and `settledAt = now` on each (their isPinned and hasUnread are left unchanged; a non-Hydra helper still in its panel is not in helpers(of:) and is not settled); then `updateDockBadge()` (803); plays SettleChime when sounds && settings.settleSound; saveLibrary() immediately. reopen (810-826) clears isSettled/settledAt, sets updatedAt = now, clears activityOrder/activityOrderDay, then `updateThreads(children(of: id).filter(\.isSettled).map(\.id))` (821) clears isSettled/settledAt on EVERY settled direct child (a different set from settle's helpers(of:)); it does not touch hasUnread and does not call updateDockBadge; saveLibrary() immediately.

finishSelectedThread: .archive, or .settle on a helper, archives with Chrome.panelSlide. .settle posts a FinishRequest(threadID:, reopens: isSettled); if no row consumes it within 80 ms the model settles or reopens itself animated. settleSelectedThread does the same regardless of the finish setting, and does nothing for a helper.

askToArchiveSelectedThread (893-912): deletes without asking (withAnimation(Chrome.panelSlide) { delete(id) }) only when `if let runtime = existingRuntime(for: id), !runtime.isLoadingHistory, runtime.turns.isEmpty, runtime.continuation == nil, runtime.draft.isEmpty, runtime.followUps.isEmpty, !runtime.isRunning`. A thread with no runtime this launch (never opened) therefore always gets the ArchiveRequest, even if it is empty. After 80 ms with no row taking the request, archives (Return's default) with Chrome.panelSlide.

delete (934-957): deletes every direct child first via `children(of: id)` (937; recursive through delete, so all descendants go, including panel helpers); selects a neighbour if selected; a Hydra head with `thread.hydra?.isFinished == false` reports finishHydraHead(id, status: .interrupted, summary: nil); discards state and the document; removes the thread; then only `if let project = project(thread.projectID)` (946) a Task deletes git checkpoints and removes the worktree when `removeWorktree || thread.hydra?.hasOwnCopy == true` (949): a thread whose project is gone gets no checkpoint or worktree cleanup; updates badge; saveLibrary() immediately.

deleteArchivedThreads (961-993): removed = archived threads plus only DIRECT children of archived threads that are not archived themselves (`archivedIDs.contains(parent) && !archivedIDs.contains(helper.id)`, 966-969; a non-archived grandchild is not collected). If the selection is removed, `self.selectedThreadID = nil` (971; no neighbour is selected, unlike delete). Unlike single delete it never calls finishHydraHead for an unfinished head, so a lead waiting on that head is not told. discardThreadState(deletingDocument: false) for each, then one Storage.deleteDocuments call; cleanup (checkpoints plus only Hydra own-copy worktrees, `thread.hydra?.hasOwnCopy == true ? thread.worktreePath : nil`, 978) is collected only `if let project = project(thread.projectID)` (977), so threads with a missing project get none; then updateDockBadge() and scheduleSave(). Source comment conflict: the doc comment (959-960) says "Worktrees stay on disk, exactly as they do after a single delete", yet both this function (978) and single delete (949) remove Hydra own-copy worktrees, and single delete also removes any worktree when called with removeWorktree: true. Port the code behaviour, not the comment.

spawnSubagent: an existing panel helper gets the prompt (enqueueFollowUp when running, else draft + send). Otherwise a new ChatThread inheriting provider, model, effort, runtimeMode, fastMode, with parentThreadID, isInPanel = true, title, hasCustomTitle = true, is appended and sent the prompt immediately. It runs in the project folder (no worktree).
closeSubagent: a running helper is added to sessionsToRelease and interrupted (session released in turnFinished); an idle one stops its session; isInPanel = false.

selectNeighbor (1079-1087): `guard let index = order.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) else { selectedThreadID = nil; return }` over sidebarThreads, so a thread not in sidebarThreads (its project collapsed, `projects.filter(\.isExpanded)` 385, a panel helper, a folded or settled parent's helper) leaves nothing selected when archived or deleted; otherwise it prefers the next row, then the previous, else nil. selectThread(offset:) (1100-1108) returns if sidebarThreads is empty; selects `order.first?.id` when there is no selection OR the current selection is not in sidebarThreads; otherwise wraps with `(index + offset + order.count) % order.count`. selectThread(number:) is 1-based and ignores out-of-range numbers.

createWorktree: requires worktreePath == nil, a repository and at least one commit. suffix = first 8 chars of lowercased UUID; folder = project name with spaces replaced by "-" and lowercased; path = Storage.worktreesDirectory/<folder>-<suffix>; branch = "droppy-code/<suffix>"; base = current git branch.

isOnScreen (1149-1156): true when `selectedThreadID == thread.id`; otherwise `guard let parent = thread.parentThreadID, parent == selectedThreadID else { return false }` (1151), so every other case requires the thread's parent to BE the selected thread. Then a panel helper (`thread.isInPanel`) counts when `!thread.isArchived`; an inline helper counts only when `!thread.isArchived` and its parent (the selected thread) exists and `!parentThread.isArchived && !parentThread.isInPanel && !parentThread.foldsHelpers && !parentThread.isSettled`. Helpers of unselected parents are never on screen.

threadNeedsAttention: skipped under WebsiteCaptures; if app active and thread on screen, marks it read only; otherwise notify(body: "Waiting for your decision.") and requestUserAttention(.informationalRequest).

turnFinished order: set lastStatus and updatedAt; non-heads get hasUnread = !(NSApp.isActive && onScreen); update badge; release a pending helper session; if autoContinue.turnFinished returns true, stop; heads call hydraHeadTurnFinished when !continues and stop; if continues, stop; chime when settings.chimeWhenFinished && status != .interrupted; notify only when not visible and settings.notifyWhenFinished, with sound nil when chimed, else .default.
markRead([UUID]) performs one array write for several threads, then scheduleSave and badge update.

requestNotificationPermission (1240-1246) asks once per launch (didRequestNotifications) and never under WebsiteCaptures. It is never called at launch: its only caller in the B2 tree is notify() (line 1251, grep), so the first authorization request comes with the first notification that is actually shown. notify is suppressed when WebsiteCaptures is on or when the app is active and the thread is on screen; the request identifier is the thread UUID string so a later notification for the same thread replaces the earlier one.

textEngine: .off -> nil; .claude -> claude engine if Claude auth is not .signedOut and executable exists; .codex -> codex engine also needing a default model id; .automatic -> codex first when preferring .codex, else claude first, each falling back to the other.
Persistence: scheduleSave debounce 400 ms, cancelled and restarted per call; saveLibrary and scheduleSave are no-ops after persistenceEnabled becomes false in saveBeforeQuit.
ProjectFile reads droppy-code.json at the project root; icon mapping test/lint/configure/build/debug with default play.

B1->B2: exactly one line changed (hunk @@ -746,7 +746,7 @@, line 749 at B2): rename(_:to:) now computes `let trimmed = title.trimmed` instead of `title.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)`.
